conflicts.note: The manufacturer publishes two figures: the Manufacturer Direct (see-through) price of $194,900 and a window-sticker MSRP of $272,900. Dealer sale prices run lower than direct (e.g., Johnson RV listed $175,610 after rebate and discount). Re-verified Oct 16, 2026: the $194,900 direct price is confirmed on both the dedicated Friday model page (published product price) and the comparison page; the sticker figure stands as logged. No rebate is published as standing pricing on either manufacturer page; lower figures quoted elsewhere are dealer rebate/discount prices, not the manufacturer's price.
conflicts.resolution: Display uses the manufacturer's published direct price, with the sticker MSRP disclosed in the price note.
